name: rsm-messenger-root
description: RSM Messenger - Production-Quality WhatsApp-Style Real-Time Messaging Application

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,ADMIN,CLIENT" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd shared && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ../mobile && npm install
scripts.build:all: cd shared && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build && cd ../admin && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build
